description: Updates integrated by Build-Iso.ps1, fetched headless from the Microsoft Update Catalog by scripts/Get-Updates.py into the work folder, C:\W11Kit\work\updates\<folder>. Each KB must match exactly one catalog entry for Windows 11 version <release> on <arch>. Each folder holds exactly its configured KBs: anything else in it is removed (lcu: only the target cumulative update). CI and monthly rebuilds can run Get-Updates.py --discover --write: per folder, the newest month's catalog entries titled '<YYYY-MM> <discover title> (KB...)' (excluding 'exclude' words); a null rule keeps the folder's pins. lcuBuild is the pinned LCU's OS build; discovery never moves to a lower one. pinned is the day the pins were last moved (--discover --write sets it): the build notes pins older than 35 days, and Run-Build.cmd asks before building with pins older than 70 days.
